Subject: LegacyBank - On-prem air-gapped deployment: hardware & offline ops follow-up

Hi Tom - thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Summary of ask:
- LegacyBank is evaluating a fully air-gapped, on-prem deployment of Redwood Private for inference serving (customer-managed network, no outbound traffic, HSM-backed keys).
- Primary workloads: production chat assistants (low-latency single-turn + multi-turn context up to 8k tokens) and nightly batch embedding jobs.

2) Open technical items we committed to follow up on (items for the hardware scoping call):
- Recommended GPU profile (model variants + batch sizing) for 50 qps peak and nightly 100k embeddings job.
- Offline operations: how to stage model artifacts, OS/firmware upgrade process in an air-gapped environment, and emergency patching process.
- Hardware procurement: vendor-validated BOM and rack footprint; Claire (cc) from Whitebox-HW may share validated SKUs.

3) Attachments: I attached the requirements doc and a proposed hardware worksheet for your ops team to review.

4) Next steps & timeline:
- Week of 8/30: hardware scoping call with Dev and Claire to review SKUs and offline ops runbook.
- By 9/7: rough cost estimate (HW + Redwood Private license + installation).
- By 9/14: PoC plan for air-gap deployment (3-week engagement).

Please let me know if anything above is incorrect. If that timeline works, I'll send a calendar invite for the scoping call (30-45 min).

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side before the scoping call: 

- All hardware must be procured through our approved vendor list; Whitebox-HW is on that list so cc'ing Claire is perfect.

Tom, Marissa - great to meet you both yesterday. A few technical notes to set expectations ahead of the scoping call: 

1) GPU / model guidance (preliminary):
- For your target (50 qps peak, mixed single/multi-turn up to 8k tokens), recommended starting profile: 4x A800 (or equivalent Ampere-class 80GB) in a single rack with a split-serving topology (2 primary inference nodes + 2 KV cache/replica nodes).
- If you need higher density or lower rack count we can evaluate 8-bit quantized variants; we'll cover tradeoffs on latency and quality on the call.

2) Offline operations / model rollout audit trail:
- Redwood Private supports an air-gap-friendly model artifact bundle (signed tarball) and a manual install command. Each install is recorded locally in the control-plane DB with a signed install record.
- For additional auditability, we can output a gzipped install manifest and a PGP-signed checksum file that your security team can ingest.

3) Object store integration:
- We support S3-compatible endpoints for batch job input/outputs behind private networking. We'll need the endpoint URL, region, and access credentials (or a service account with object-store read-only access) for the PoC.

4) Upgrades & emergency patching:
- Recommended process: pre-stage patches on an air-gapped jump host provided by your team; Redwood provides a signed patch bundle and a documented install sequence.
- Emergency hotfixes require a manual approval flow; we'll document SLAs for turnaround during the PoC.

5) HW vendor coordination:
- Claire - if you can confirm the validated SKUs and rack U sizes we'll map the BOM to the proposed topology.

I'll bring a short deck to the scoping call with examples and latency/cost tradeoffs. Marissa - I can do Tue 8/31 10:00 PT as well.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai
